canonical_base_definition: One native 2022 JRC SH-cohort/DHW-branch vector; exclude entire district SH cohort and all its DHW branches; separate circulation; retain solar DHW and existing advanced-electric SH visibly; no source averaging or count-based energy rescaling
unit: GWh/year thermal service; kWh/dwelling-equivalent/year only as explicit normalization

admission_criteria.1_quantity: Annual source-model thermal service from SH and DHW, circulation separately accounted
admission_criteria.2_boundary: 2022 national JRC household technology cohort; explicit source units and KSH normalization-only denominator
admission_criteria.3_support: Direct official JRC workbook and technical methodology; focused independent reviewer reconciliation of the SAME source, not independent empirical corroboration
admission_criteria.4_applicability: Hungary and same 2022 year; applicable only as national annual calibration reference, not as household/archetype demand
admission_criteria.5_contradictions: No contradiction to the native source sums. Current Eurostat end-use decomposition differences remain explicit and coherently stress-tested; the JRC reference is not promoted to actual end-use truth
admission_criteria.6_reproduction: Pinned binary source hash, native cells/codes/formulas, exact extract and consumer identities
admission_criteria.7_debt: Named validation debts below bind every stronger population/programme claim
admission_criteria.8_label: DER and E2_PROVISIONAL_BASE; never OBS because consumed

validation_debt.missing_exact_evidence: Household energy coverage versus occupied conventional dwellings, including secondary/vacant dwelling consumption and district-cohort membership
validation_debt.possible_supplier: Public KSH and MEKH/Eurostat scope documentation or a documented calibrated population-inference study
validation_debt.claim_upgraded: Actual occupied non-district dwelling mean rather than normalized calibration reference

validation_debt.missing_exact_evidence: Separation of statistical revisions from JRC SH/WH reallocations and observed district-cohort electric/solar DHW assignment
validation_debt.possible_supplier: Public Hungarian end-use methodology, survey controls or a validated coherent allocation estimator
validation_debt.claim_upgraded: Target-population SH/WH split and district exclusion

validation_debt.missing_exact_evidence: Hungarian installed-equipment useful/final conversion and delivered-service boundary validation
validation_debt.possible_supplier: Public representative field or stock-calibrated engineering evidence
validation_debt.claim_upgraded: Observed/validated useful heat rather than provisional JRC model conversion

validation_debt.missing_exact_evidence: Energy assignment to KSH mixed-fuel and building archetype cells; source-native mixed-fuel expenditure/use shares and SH/DHW links or a controlled estimator
validation_debt.possible_supplier: Representative public evidence plus explicit constrained calibration and structural sensitivity
validation_debt.claim_upgraded: Archetype demand and selected programme-cohort savings; direct average multiplication remains forbidden

validation_debt.missing_exact_evidence: Same-boundary weather/service normalization when transferring 2022 annual heat to hourly reference weather
validation_debt.possible_supplier: Existing physical B02/B06 model and observed HungaroMet time support with documented calibration
validation_debt.claim_upgraded: Hourly demand and peak-load handoff; annual energy alone does not determine peak

structural_diagnostics: Native paired JRC vector versus same-year Eurostat end-use controls
Fixed H8000 total with jointly replaced SH/WH shares; changes only excluded district branch. Consistent national/district updates cancel exactly in non-district ledger; not non-district uncertainty
District non-H8000 DHW allocation stress does not change total national energy
review_scope: Independent focused source, native cohort and code review; not full V1 scientific validation; exact artifact hashes and test receipt bind the checkpoint
